name: Joker Halloween makeup and cosplay transformations
what_it_is: Videos show people doing Joker/clown-style Halloween makeup and cosplay transformations — white face paint, green hair, red grins — plus Joker-themed nail art, a pet's Joker costume, and Joker meme or lip-sync clips. A few videos only loosely touch the theme (a hydro-dipped cap, a Batman mukbang, a Spider-Man toy skit).
